curiosities: Its Xenon processor has three PowerPC cores made by IBM.
Early failures, shown by three red lights round the power button, cost Microsoft over a billion dollars in repairs.
Kinect, a camera to play without a controller, came in 2010.
It plays many original Xbox games through emulation.
It launched on 22 November 2005, ahead of every other console of its generation.
Its graphics chip, Xenos, was made by ATI, with 10 MB of fast embedded memory.
Achievements and Gamerscore began with it.
Xbox Live Arcade sold small downloadable games.
An add-on HD DVD drive came out in 2006.
The slim Xbox 360 S of 2010 has Wi-Fi built in.
